$meta.direction: Light chrome, dark full-bleed image/video bands — the 'in between' of 5c.co (dark) and shaferplasticsurgery.com / mdplasticsurgery.com (light).
$meta.rule: CLAUDE.md §6 — tokens are the ONLY source of style values. No hard-coded hex, px spacing, or font sizes in component files. Need a new value? Add a token.
$meta.contrast: Every pair below verified against WCAG 2.2. Ratios recorded in design/art-direction.md.

ink.use: primary text on light; DARK BAND ground

ink-soft.use: secondary text on light (7.86 on paper)

paper.use: primary light ground — warm off-white, NOT #fff and NOT #f9fafb

muted-on-light.use: secondary copy on any light band — AA on all three (min 5.05)

muted-on-dark.use: secondary copy on any dark band (min 7.10)

accent-light.use: THE accent, on light grounds. Links, CTA fill, focus ring.

accent-dark.use: THE accent, on dark grounds. Same hue, lifted for legibility.

rule-on-light.use: hairline dividers on light — decorative only

rule-on-dark.use: hairline dividers on dark — decorative only, NEVER text

color.$forbidden: No third colour. No purple/indigo/violet. No 'medical blue'. No gradients. One accent, two lightnesses, that is all (§4).

display.note: High-contrast editorial serif. Deliberately NOT Playfair Display — Playfair is the default 'elegant' choice and reads as template. Provisional pending a specimen pass.

body.note: Neo-grotesque with a genuine Light. Deliberately NOT Inter — Inter as display is the single loudest AI-default tell.

family.$rule: Self-hosted woff2, font-display: swap, metric-matched fallback to prevent CLS (§6).

scale.$note: Fluid, clamped between 390px and 1440px viewports. Base is 17px, not 16px — uniform 16px everywhere is a template tell.

measure.$rule: Body copy never runs full-bleed (§4 'narrow, confident measure').

radius.$rule: Used SPARINGLY. 'Rounded everything' is an AI-default tell (§4). Default is square: cards, images, and bands have NO radius. Radius exists for buttons and inputs only.

motion.$rule: 150–400ms, custom cubic-bezier, never a bare 'ease'. Every transition wrapped in prefers-reduced-motion (§6).
motion.$reduced: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) — duration 0.01ms, no transform, video never fetched.

layout.$rule: Must hold at 320px and at 200% zoom (definition of done).

elevation.$rule: NO drop shadows (§4 explicitly). Depth comes from the light/dark band system and hairline rules. This key exists to document the absence.
